name: com.felina.arcoloringbook
description: Professional AR image tracking and texture capture system for Unity. Transform physical images into interactive AR experiences with GPU-accelerated homography unwarp, quality-based capture, and multi-version support (Unity 2019.4-6.3+). Perfect for coloring books, educational apps, AR games, and interactive marketing. Supports ARFoundation 2.x through 6.x with automatic version detection. Includes native C++ performance, device stability detection, and easy drag-and-drop setup.

samples.description: Complete example scene demonstrating AR image tracking, content spawning, and real-time texture capture. Includes pre-configured scanner, sample reference images, 3D content prefabs, and material setup. Perfect starting point for learning the system.
